sources.title: [2605.21768] Memory-R2: Fair Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Memory ...
sources.snippet: Memory-augmented LLM agents enable interactions that extend beyond finite context windows by storing, updating, and reusing information across sessions. However, training such agents with reinforcement learning in multi-session environments is challenging because memory turns the agent's past actions into part of its future environment.
